method:
I worked from decoded half-scale frames only: out/ep06/v3/ep06_film.mp4, 960×540, 17,023 frames verified by ffprobe, decoded index = absolute frame. There was no playback and no audio.

**Reading.** I read PLAYBOOK §4-§8, DIRECTION §1-§12, TRANSCRIPT P01-P08, the editorial ledger rows C00-C07 and C25 (by grep), and the previous reviews docs/ep06/fixes/S1_v2.json, S2_v2.json, S3_v2.json and range_S1-S3_v2.md.

**Extraction and automated checks.** I extracted frames 0-5139 to out/ep06/review/v3/S1-S3/clip_0_5139.mp4 (crf 10; 5,140 frames verified). tools/static_check.py --offset 0 found 0 frozen stretches and 0 empty frames (motion median 9.29, p10 2.42, min 0.58). A custom profile (scratchpad prof.py) recorded per-frame diff, 15-frame motion, mean luma, luma std and the fraction of pixels above 200. It found no stretch of 20 f or more with 15-frame motion under 2.0, and no frame with mean luma under 12. The cut and whip list is in the boundaries field. The preview flashes peak at mean luma 59-76 with 0% of pixels above 200.

**Measurements.**
- Label onsets, by bright-pixel counts per frame: 'On your PC's own drive', 'Gone?', 'Not yet.', 'Only the note', 'NTFS', 'clusters', 'Fits…', the directions chip, and the preview tag widths at f1230-1248, 1276-1292 and 1324-1340.
- The signature card's paper top and coral-tab top at f380-470.
- Cyan pixels per 24 px cell from f4840 to f4990, every 10 f.
- Static-region motion in the opening desk shot (f20-210).
- Text heights on 2× crops with pixel rulers.
- The cyan RGB of the opener route at f2045.
- Card width and clipping at f4600 and f4650.

**Images.** I used 13 images, all in out/ep06/review/v3/S1-S3/:

| Image | Contents |
|---|---|
| s1_overview | 59 frames, step 24 |
| s1_dense_a | 60 frames at word frames 0-484 |
| s1_dense_b | 63 frames, 518-1408 |
| s2_overview | 59 frames, step 30 |
| s2_dense | 88 frames |
| s3_overview | 59 frames, step 33 |
| s3_dense | 72 frames |
| crops_text_a, crops_text_b, crops_text_c | 2× crops of every must-read label and footnote |
| boundaries | 39 frames across 1400-1418, 3158-3184 and 5086-5145 |
| mix_a | full f4920 and f2620; crops of 'Unused', 'boxes and cards', the keycaps at f1922 and f1932, and 'Free' at f4254 |
| gaps | 32 frames of the quieter stretches: 1000-1210, 2040-2110, 3690-3770, 4570-4670, 4840-4860 |

**Other checks.** The S1-S3 render logs contain 0 '[kit]' warnings. A grep found no Math.random or Date in src/ep06. The cue JSONs, read as data only:

| Section | Cues | Per minute | Impacts |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | 10 | 12.8 | f187, f397 |
| S2 | 13 | 13.3 | f2755, f2881 |
| S3 | 15 | 13.9 | f4526 |

I rendered no full-res stills, because every doubtful label measured above the floors on the half-scale frames.

**Scoring.** score_100 = Σ(criterion × weight)/10 with weights 25/15/20/15/5/15/5. The range score is the frame-weighted mean of the three sections (1409, 1758 and 1937 frames): 86.6.
